svg.title: Correct three common shortcuts
svg.desc: More GHz does not guarantee less time: Instruction count and average CPI also enter the CPU-time formula.. More RAM is not automatically faster: Extra capacity helps when the workload needs it.. A cache is not a register bank: Caches hold copies of addressed memory blocks.. A GPU is not always preferable: Parallelism and transfer costs must suit the workload.
svg.text: More GHz does not guarantee less time
Instruction count and average CPI also enter the CPU-time formula.
More RAM is not automatically faster
Extra capacity helps when the workload needs it.
A cache is not a register bank
Caches hold copies of addressed memory blocks.
A GPU is not always preferable
Parallelism and transfer costs must suit the workload.
Original teaching illustration; assumptions are explained in the chapter.
